saw_lines: Buyers of a luxury hat ask one question first: will it hold its shape on a trip?
So the first line has to prove the hat holds its shape, or the buyer scrolls past before any offer comes up.
Your site offers 20% off full-price styles, yet 0 of 23 copy ads mention it. Open three new ads with that offer in the first line.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 2 Nov 2026
points: Your site offers 20% off full-price styles, yet 0 of 23 copy ads mention it. A new buyer has no reason to act. Open three new ads with that offer in the first line and print it on the creative.

22 of 23 copy ads open on one line, “True luxury is felt in the details.” No other opener gets airtime. Name two or three angles like the Squishee sun hat and the Trek straw tote, and run each against it.

One exact copy runs in 22 of 23 ads, so buyers keep seeing the same words. Keep the body you have, but change the opening line and the creative in each version. Shoot a fresh image or clip for every variation.
0 of 28 live ads show a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing concrete to trust. Pull one real figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it on the creative.

ads_1: Offer led creative for hats and bags, with three new openers beyond luxury
